propositions: Assignee resolver is injected as an attribute on the outbound mapper using try/except blocks, making failures silent and invisible to type checkers
When attribute injection fails or is missing, assignee resolution silently degrades to non-authoritative mode, causing permanent diff churn
The Data Center adapter copied the getattr discovery pattern but the attribute was never set on it, making its entire authoritative branch dead code
Two implementers (Cloud and DC) independently discover the resolver via getattr with no declared contract, and each has different lifecycle requirements
The resolver parameter must be threaded explicitly through compute_update_fields and diff_canonical_fields to the resolve_assignee call site
DC's constructor-bound resolver should be a declared parameter on _DCOutbound, with explicit parameter passing taking precedence to preserve current overwrite semantics
